description: Run by the Dependencies workflow (docs/releasing.md). main gets every update but majors (and 0.x minors, as breaking), grouped once a week, and security fixes at once: merged once their checks pass, then released as a fix. next gets the majors.

packageRules.description: The stable line: the week's updates in one pull request
The stable line takes no major update: they go to next
Nor a 0.x minor (0.12 → 0.13), which Cargo treats as breaking: they go to next too
next takes the other updates from main, through `cargo ship sync`
Except the 0.x minors, which main doesn't take
The Slint fork, pinned to a commit on purpose
